tasks.task: Find a popular recipe for a chocolate chip cookie and list the ingredients and preparation steps.
tasks.answer: Found the popular recipe "Best Chocolate Chip Cookies" on Allrecipes (4.6 stars, 19,337 ratings, 14,916 reviews) via site search for "chocolate chip cookies". Ingredients: 1 cup butter (softened); 3/4 cup white sugar; 3/4 cup packed brown sugar; 2 large eggs; 2 teaspoons vanilla extract; 1 teaspoon baking soda; 2 teaspoons hot water; 1/2 teaspoon salt; 3 cups all-purpose flour; 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips; 1 cup chopped walnuts. Preparation steps: 1) Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C); 2) Cream butter and sugars until fluffy; 3) Beat in eggs and vanilla; 4) Dissolve baking soda in hot water and add to batter with salt; 5) Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and walnuts; 6) Drop rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets; 7) Bake 10 minutes until edges brown; 8) Cool on sheets briefly; 9) Transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

tasks.answer:
Recipe name: 5-Minute Microwave Nutella Cake
URL: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/230649/5-minute-microwave-nutella-cake/
Constraint checks: Prep Time = 10 mins (< 30 minutes); chocolate ingredient present (2 tablespoons chocolate-hazelnut spread such as Nutella, plus cocoa powder); user rating = 4.6/5 from 61 ratings (>= 4 stars).
Ingredients:
- ¼ cup self-rising flour
- ¼ cup white sugar
- 1 large egg
- 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 3 tablespoons milk
- 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, or more to taste
- 2 tablespoons chocolate-hazelnut spread (such as Nutella), or more to taste
- ½ teaspoon vanilla extract
- pinch of salt (Optional)
Step-by-step instructions:
1. Stir self-rising flour, sugar, egg, oil, milk, cocoa powder, chocolate-hazelnut spread, vanilla, and a pinch of salt together in a large mug until batter is smooth.
2. Cook in the microwave on full power until cake has risen in the mug and is set in the center, 1 minute and 30 seconds to 2 minutes and 30 seconds.

tasks.task: Search for a high-protein vegetarian chili recipe on Allrecipes that has at least 50 reviews and a rating of 4 stars or higher. Provide the ingredient list, cooking time, and a brief description of the cooking steps.
tasks.answer:
Recipe: Meatiest Vegetarian Chili from Your Slow Cooker (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/132394/meatiest-vegetarian-chili-from-your-slow-cooker/) — Rating: 4.6 stars, 232 reviews (meets ≥4 stars and ≥50 reviews). High-protein vegetarian chili with 21g protein per serving from tofu and black beans.

INGREDIENTS: 1/2 cup olive oil; 4 onions, chopped; 2 green bell peppers, seeded and chopped; 2 red bell peppers, seeded and chopped; 1 (14 oz) package firm tofu, drained and cubed; 4 cloves garlic, minced; 4 (15.5 oz) cans black beans, drained; 2 (15 oz) cans crushed tomatoes; 6 tablespoons chili powder; 2 tablespoons dried oregano; 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar; 1 tablespoon liquid hot pepper sauce (e.g., Tabasco); 2 teaspoons ground cumin; 2 teaspoons salt; 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper.

COOKING TIME: Prep 25 mins; Cook 6 hrs 15 mins; Total 6 hrs 40 mins.

COOKING STEPS (brief): 1) Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; sauté onions until softening, then add bell peppers, cubed tofu, and garlic and cook until vegetables are lightly browned and tender (~10 minutes). 2) Place drained black beans in a slow cooker, add the tofu-vegetable mixture and crushed tomatoes, stir in chili powder, oregano, vinegar, hot pepper sauce, cumin, salt, and pepper; cover and cook on Low for 6 to 8 hours.
